added.summary: TSX classes that mask an element and everything inside it with a gradient's alpha, as CSS's `mask-image`: `mask-[linear-gradient(to_right,black,transparent)]`, a radial or conic gradient the same way; opaque draws, transparent hides. The gradient is measured over the element's own box, and an inner mask replaces an outer one. `mask-none` clears it. Only gradients mask; an image URL is no class.
